title: Onboard sable-13b v1.1: metadata, perf profiles, and changelog automation
author: Elena Park
release_notes: Onboarded sable-13b v1.1 with updated metadata, performance profiles for common deployment targets (A100/V100, T4, CPU) and automated changelog generation during model publish. Improvements: int8 quantization support and KV-cache layout optimization. No breaking API changes.
description: Add sable-13b v1.1 to the registry: metadata, performance profiles for standard contexts, and automation to emit changelog entries during model publish. Motivation: v1.1 introduces a KV-cache layout optimization and official int8 quantized weights which materially change throughput/latency. Publishing curated perf profiles prevents regressions and gives customers predictable serving options. This PR includes: a) metadata json with checksum and provenance, b) perf profiles for 2048 and 4096 context lengths (A100, T4, V100, CPU baseline and int8 variants), c) integration of the changelog-generator into the model publish pipeline so model additions update release notes automatically, d) docs page for customers with recommended configs. Checklist: - [x] metadata schema update and validation - [x] perf profiling runs attached and validated - [x] changelog-generator hook added to publish pipeline - [x] docs updated (models/sable.md) - [x] QA perf re-run and signoff (Priya) - [x] CI green (after one rerun). See commit messages and perf summary below. Note: perf-ci initially timed out on the 4096 run; I increased the timeout and re-ran. All numbers in perf_profiles are median of 3 runs.
